description_en: Queries the blocking data of an ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance
description_zh: 调用GetBlockingDetailList接口，查询RDS SQL Server实例的锁阻塞列表
name: GetBlockingDetailList

parameters.help_en: The ID of the database instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Set this parameter to a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页最大记录数，取值大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The hash value of the SQL statement. The hash values of SQL statements of the same type are the same
parameters.help_zh: SQL哈希值。将SQL语句进行Hash之后得出的值，同一种SQL对应同一个QueryHash
parameters.name: query_hash

parameters.help_en: The name of the database. Separate multiple database names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 数据库名。传入多个数据库时，各个数据库名称间使用英文逗号（,）进行分隔
parameters.name: db_name_list

List.description_en: The details of the data returned

items.description_en: The details of the data returned

CurrentCollectionTime.description_en: The time when the blocking data was collected. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
CurrentCollectionTime.description_zh: 阻塞的采集时间。格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒

LoginId.description_en: The username that is used for the logon

QueryHash.description_en: The hash value of the SQL statement

StartTime.description_en: The time when the execution started. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 开始执行的时间。格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒

WaitTimeMs.description_en: The duration of the blocking. Unit: milliseconds

WaitType.description_en: The wait type. For more information about wait types, see sys.dm_os_wait_stats (Transact-SQL) (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/relational-databases/system-dynamic-management-views/sys-dm-os-wait-stats-transact-sql?view=sql-server-ver15)
WaitType.description_zh: 等待类型。更多等待类型及说明，请参见等待类型 (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/relational-databases/system-dynamic-management-views/sys-dm-os-wait-stats-transact-sql?view=sql-server-ver15)

PageNo.description_en: The page number of the page returned

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page

Total.description_en: The total number of entries returned

Message.description_en:
The returned message.

If the request is successful, Successful is returned. Otherwise, an error message such as an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
请求返回消息。
请求成功时该参数返回Successful，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否执行成功：

true：执行成功。
false：执行失败
